# Version 4.151.0
> **Performance and WASM for .NET 11** · Released July 30, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.151.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.151.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.151.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.151.0 brings significant performance gains and WASM support for .NET 11 on Emscripten 5.0.6. Hot colour-conversion and HarfBuzz text paths are ported to allocation-free managed code, eliminating per-call heap pressure on rendering hot loops. The WASM build adopts the exnref exception-handling model required by .NET 11, and Skia m151 upstream stability fixes are included.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Engine

- **Skia m151 upstream stability fixes** — Multiple waves of upstream chrome/m151 bug fixes merged, plus the initial m151 milestone bump, landing engine-level rendering and text stability improvements. ([#4294](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4294), [#4312](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4312), [#4382](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4382), [#4443](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4443), [#4489](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4489))
- **CPU raster regression fixed** — SK_ENABLE_LEGACY_SHADERCONTEXT was inadvertently removed during an upstream Skia sync, causing CPU raster rendering to regress. It has been restored. ([#4428](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4428))

## API Surface

- **SKColor hex parsing optimized with Span overloads** — SKColor.Parse/TryParse now accept ReadOnlySpan<char>, avoiding a string allocation when parsing colours from substrings or stack-allocated buffers. ([#4345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4345))
- **SKColor and SKPMColor conversions ported to managed code** — The SKColor↔SKColorF and single-value SKPMColor premultiply/unpremultiply operations are now implemented in managed integer math, eliminating P/Invoke round-trips for these common hot-path operations. ([#4370](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4370), [#4385](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4385))
- **GRContextOptions unsafe modifier removed** — The unnecessary unsafe modifier is removed, improving interoperability with assemblies that do not permit unsafe code. ([#3991](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3991))

## Bug Fixes

- **Native resource leak in SKImage.FromEncodedData fixed** — The overload accepting SKData and a crop rectangle leaked the native image object when the crop was applied. The handle is now properly released on all code paths. ([#3997](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3997))

## Platform

- **WASM: Emscripten 5.0.6 static libraries for .NET 11** — New static libraries built with Emscripten 5.0.6 and the exnref exception-handling model are added, with a CI test job to catch regressions on future .NET 11 WASM builds. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4459](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4459), [#4487](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4487), [#4488](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4488))
- **Skia submodule updated to drop SK_BUILD_FOR_WASM redefinition warning** — A macro redefinition compiler warning on WASM builds is eliminated by bumping the Skia submodule. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3788](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3788))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1: Buffer.AddUtf8(string) is now allocation-free via a pooled UTF-8 encode path, Tag.Parse drops its per-call char[4] allocation, and WASM static libraries are updated for Emscripten 5.0.6.
